title: Storyline Day 4: Living-off-the-Land RMM Tunnel, AMSI Bypass & Kerberoasting
description: Detects Day 4 of the 7-day multi-pillar adversary storyline: PowerShell encoded command execution and AMSI bypass attempts (EventID 4104), RMM tunnel creation (cloudflared.exe), and Kerberoasting RC4 ticket requests (EventID 4769) across GOAD servers.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows PowerShell Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and ('Event ID' in ('4104', '4769', '1') and ('Command Line' like '*-EncodedCommand*' or 'Command Line' like '*cloudflared*' or 'Event ID' = '4769')) | stats count as lateral_events, distinctcount('Event ID') as distinct_signals by 'Host Name (Server)', 'Event ID' | sort -lateral_events
falsepositives: Approved Cloudflare Tunnel connectors on designated edge gateway hosts
Legacy Active Directory service accounts explicitly configured for RC4 encryption
investigation_notes: Review PowerShell Script Block Text (EventID 4104) on winterfell for AmsiUtils reflection.
Check EventID 4769 service ticket requests for encryption type 0x17 targeting MSSQLSvc and HTTP SPNs.
